### Game and tool

- Game/platform:
- Tool/addon version or commit:
- Blender/Python version (if relevant):
- Installed archive or extracted files:

### Reproduction

Logical input filename, steps and full error text. Do not attach game assets,
archives, keys or saves. Remove private machine paths from logs.

### Expected and actual result

For visual bugs, include a screenshot if appropriate, preview mode, clip/frame,
and whether this was a fresh import. Explain the reference being compared.

### Checks already tried

List actual results. It is fine to say a check was not run. If AI helped prepare
this report, verify its claims against the output you actually observed.
